html:
Ha Long not only welcomes visitors with clear blue beaches and beautiful stops, but Ha Long also welcomes visitors with delicious and attractive dishes. Let’s check out the snacks in Ha Long below with Vietlook.

Bun be be

This is a famous breakfast dish in Ha Long. Be be is a specialty in Ha Long sea area. The mantis shrimp here has firm and delicious meat. If you have the opportunity to visit Ha Long, enjoy a bowl of be be vermicelli to fully enjoy its own delicious flavor.

Bun cu ky

This is a breakfast dish in Ha Long that many diners choose. Cu ky is small but has big claws. The meat is sweet and fragrant. When eaten with vermicelli, it brings a delicious and attractive flavor.

Eggs, blood stewed with mugwort, this is a nutritious dish that tourists cannot miss when traveling to Ha Long, with the sweetness of blood, the bitterness of mugwort mixed together to create a delicious flavor.

Squid roll cake is a famous specialty of Ha Long, to enjoy this dish, tourists can enjoy it right at the street food stalls, the dish is very attractive and makes tourists remember it forever.

Sea cucumber, crab is processed into many different dishes such as sweet and sour stir-fry, making spring rolls, crab eggs… this is one of the dishes chosen by many diners.

Stir-fried snails: A quite famous snack, especially when night falls, tourists can take a walk to enjoy the dish while admiring the scenery or chatting together, there is nothing more interesting.

Ha Long pearl yogurt, a quite famous dish, especially for young people when they have enjoyed sightseeing, they can sit somewhere to enjoy pearl yogurt while admiring the scenery of the sea and islands.

Nodding Cake

A famous dish in Ha Long, looks like Northern Pho or Southern Banh Uot, the cake is spread very thinly then rolled up, when enjoying, diners will dip it in fish sauce with chicken fat, fried onions, minced meat, chili or khau nhuc… bringing a delicious flavor of its own.

Salt-roasted mantis shrimp

A typical seafood dish of the coastal region, processed very elaborately and accompanied by spices such as: lemongrass, oil, salt, pepper… and through skillful processing will bring diners the delicious flavor of the coastal region.

Geoduck

A dish chosen by many gourmet diners, when enjoying it once, you will forever remember the delicious flavor of geoduck, with a refreshing taste, especially when steamed and mixed with famous aromatic spices, a nutritious dish chosen by many diners when having the opportunity to set foot in Ha Long.

Tien Yen Crocodile

A delicious dish in its own right and can be prepared into many different dishes, including duck and goose, Tien Tien Crocodile meat… all of which bring a unique flavor to the coastal cuisine.

Ha Long Dried Shrimp Floss

This is one of the dishes that many diners not only enjoy but also buy as gifts, with accompanying dishes such as white rice, sticky rice, porridge, bread… many diners still choose to eat with hot white rice as the most attractive.

Cockles

They look like clams but are bigger, and are a nutritious specialty in Quang Ninh. Cockles are used to make many dishes such as: grilled, steamed, cooked in soup, stir-fried with noodles or eaten with vegetables and dipping sauce, or used on drinking tables…

In addition, when talking about Ha Long snacks, visitors should enjoy dishes such as: Not Gu cake, Quang Yen sour sausage, Hoanh Bo sticky rice wine, nem chao, balut, mussel porridge… visitors can enjoy them at markets or roadside eateries, there is nothing more interesting.
